summary: A test-layout decision and a correct helper. The repository's AGENTS.md says test organisation never gets an ADR and test-only changes never go in the changelog. The right review is empty; the tempting wrong one demands the document.
lesson: Do not demand a document the repository's own rules say is unnecessary

must_not_find.why: AGENTS.md reserves ADRs for structural decisions and names test organisation as explicitly out of scope. A finding asking for one is the exact error the lesson records. The diff never writes these words: the decision is in test/README.md, and ADRs are only mentioned in AGENTS.md and docs/adr/, outside the diff.
AGENTS.md: test-only changes never go in CHANGELOG.md. The word appears nowhere in the diff.
